action_items.item: JRN-133: The acceptance matrix says System Health should list the uniqueness rules as applied. The UI (SystemHealth.jsx UniquenessRules) shows only the 'not applied' rules and shows nothing when all are applied. That is what journeys.md JRN-133 describes. The applied list exists only in GET /api/admin/ops .uniqueness, which returns all 5 rules with status 'applied'. If an 'applied' list is wanted on screen, it is a small UI addition.

Test residue on preview: about 25 tscheck-3g-* customers and bookings were created, including 3 Orion flats and 2 Villa Block P flats, plus small receipts, waivers and manual bills on those bookings. The live booking count went from 82 to 107, and the Outstanding headline went up by the overdue totals of those test bookings. One Villa Block P construction stage was marked completed by the JRN-128 test; that tower had no seeded bookings. No seeded rows were changed. The nightly 03:00 IST refresh replaces all of this.
The backend frontend-auth path at localhost:3000 returns 404 on login, so the browser checks were run through the preview URL (the ingress path).

checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_receipt_double_click.py
checks.evidence: Ran 5 times: two parallel POST /api/payments with the same Idempotency-Key gave 2xx/2xx with the same id and receipt_number. Each time the booking had 1 receipt, the ledger moved by +1 line and total_jama moved by +100000 paise once.

checks.criterion: JRN-126 Two users book one flat
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_two_users_one_flat.py
checks.evidence: Ran 3 times on Orion flats (admin and sales in parallel): one 201, the other 409 FLAT_NOT_AVAILABLE 'Flat OR-203 was just taken by another booking'. Each flat ended with 1 Active booking and status Booked.

checks.criterion: JRN-127 Waiver approved twice / approve vs reject
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_waiver_race.py
checks.evidence: Pending waivers raised by accounts@ on a tscheck booking. Double approve, 3 times: [200, 409 'Already approved'], 1 Approved with a cn_number. Approve vs reject, 3 times: one 409, and never ended Rejected with a credit note. Credit-note numbers unique. WV-2627-0004 left untouched.

checks.criterion: JRN-128 Stage completed twice at once
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_stage_twice.py
checks.evidence: Villa Block P with 2 tscheck bookings: parallel POST /api/blocks/{id}/construction/stage gave [200, 409 'Stage already completed' ALREADY_COMPLETED]. Each booking got +1 bill; no duplicate installment_seq or bill numbers. The first attempt used accounts@ and got 403 for missing permission (a test-setup issue); it was rerun with two admin sessions.

checks.criterion: JRN-133 Uniqueness rules on System Health
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_uniqueness.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/admin/ops .uniqueness returns all 5 rules with status 'applied': waiver number, credit-note number, refund number, ledger line (booking + sequence), one live booking per flat.

checks.criterion: JRN-133 Uniqueness rules on System Health
checks.name: p3g-system-health-uniqueness
checks.evidence: Settings, System Health card renders (ops KPIs visible). ops-uniqueness-warning count is 0. No console errors. The rule names are not listed on screen when applied (see the note).

checks.criterion: JRN-137 Fresh figures right after a write
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_fresh_reads.py
checks.evidence: After a ₹5,000 cash receipt, the next reads already showed it: booking summary jama +500000, customer-status cash_received +500000, outstanding-v2 jama +500000, the receipt in customer payments, and a changed collections-v2 total. After the waiver approval, outstanding-v2 waived went up by 210000 (₹2,000 plus GST) and outstanding went down at once.

checks.criterion: PRE-01 Manual bill counts in Outstanding
checks.name: test_tscheck_3g_manual_bill.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/demands/manual for ₹20,000 due 35 days ago: outstanding-v2 outstanding +2000000 paise, band_31-60 +2000000, booking summary outstanding +2000000, customer-status account_dues +2000000, and net_balance = outstanding - advance.

checks.name: p3g-fresh-after-write-manual-bill
checks.evidence: BK-2627-2953 (tscheck): after the receipt and manual bill, the booking page at once showed Received ₹5,000, 'Next bill due ₹20,000 · tscheck-3g-ui manual', and Due ₹30.9 L, matching the API summary outstanding of 309324400 paise.

checks.criterion: Regression smoke: login, Home, Reports hub
checks.name: p3g-regression-smoke
checks.evidence: admin@kkt.in logged in and Home showed ₹ figures. Outstanding & ageing, Collections, Bank-wise receipts and Customer status each opened with a sentence and a ₹ table, with no report-error and no error toasts.
